basic.name: Gilnean Cocktail
basic.description:
Hurl a flask that deals 55~~0.04~~ damage to the first enemy hit and explodes for 220~~0.04~~ damage to enemies in a cone behind them.

Worgen: Razor Swipe
Swipe forward, damaging enemies hit.

basic.name: Inner Beast
basic.description: Gain 50% Attack Speed for 3 seconds. Basic Attacks refresh this duration, and reduce the cooldown of Inner Beast by 0.5 seconds.

basic.name: Darkflight
basic.description:
Shapeshift into a Worgen and leap at an enemy dealing 88~~0.04~~ damage.

Worgen: Disengage
Roll away and shapeshift into a Human.

basic.name: Inner Beast
basic.description: Gain 50% Attack Speed for 3 seconds. Basic Attacks refresh this duration, and reduce the cooldown of Inner Beast by 0.5 seconds.

basic.name: Razor Swipe
basic.description:
Swipe in the targeted direction, dealing 126~~0.04~~ damage to enemies hit.

Human: Gilnean Cocktail
Damage the first enemy hit and deal heavy damage behind them.

basic.name: Disengage
basic.description:
Roll away and shapeshift into a Human.

Human: Darkflight
Leap at an enemy and shapeshift into a Worgen.

heroic.name: Go for the Throat
heroic.description: Leap at an enemy Hero and shapeshift into a Worgen, slashing for 355~~0.04~~ damage. If this kills them, the Ability can be used a second time within 10 seconds for free.

heroic.name: Cursed Bullet
heroic.description:
Greymane shapeshifts into a Human and fires a bullet that hits the first enemy Hero in its path, dealing 35% of their current Health in damage.

Does not affect Vehicles.

trait.name: Curse of the Worgen
trait.description:
Greymane can use certain Abilities to shapeshift between a Human and a Worgen.

While Human, Greymane's Basic Attacks are ranged.

While Worgen, Greymane gains 10 Armor, and his Basic Attacks become melee but deal 40% more damage.

mount.name: Summon Mount
mount.description: Shapeshift into Human form and increase Greymane's Movement Speed by 40%.

level1.name: Wolfheart
level1.description: Increase the cooldown reduction from Basic Attacks during Inner Beast from 0.5 to 1.2 seconds, and Worgen Form's Armor bonus from 10 to 15.

level1.name: Perfect Aim
level1.description: Increases Gilnean Cocktail's range by 30% and refunds 45 Mana if it hits an enemy Hero.

level1.name: Viciousness
level1.description: Increases Inner Beast's duration to 4 seconds, and causes Ability damage to also refresh its duration.

level4.name: Thick Skin
level4.description: Using Darkflight grants 50 Physical Armor against the next 2 Hero Basic Attacks while in Worgen Form, reducing the damage taken by 50%.

level4.name: Insatiable
level4.description: Inner Beast causes Basic Attacks to restore 10 Mana, and reduce the cooldown of Healing Fountain by 0.5 seconds.

level7.name: Quicksilver Bullets
level7.description: Increases Greymane's Human Basic Attack range by 1.1.

level7.name: Incendiary Elixir
level7.description:
Quest: Reduce the cooldown of Gilnean Cocktail by 2 seconds. Every time Greymane hits an enemy Hero with the explosion damage from Gilnean Cocktail, increase its explosion damage by 25, up to 375.

Reward: After hitting 15 Heroes, the cooldown is reduced by an additional 3 seconds.

level7.name: Wizened Duelist
level7.description: Quest: Every 6 Human Basic Attacks against Heroes increase Basic Attack damage by 1%, up to 30%. Worgen Basic Attacks grant credit for 3 Basic Attacks. Half of this bonus is lost upon death.

level10.name: Go for the Throat
level10.description: Leap at an enemy Hero and shapeshift into a Worgen, slashing for 355~~0.04~~ damage. If this kills them, the Ability can be used a second time within 10 seconds for free.

level10.name: Cursed Bullet
level10.description:
Greymane shapeshifts into a Human and fires a bullet that hits the first enemy Hero in its path, dealing 35% of their current Health in damage.

Does not affect Vehicles.

level13.name: Running Wild
level13.description: Increases Darkflight and Disengage's range by 35%, and reduce their cooldowns by 1 second.

level13.name: Unfettered Assault
level13.description: Increases Razor Swipe's lunge distance by 60%, and Worgen Basic Attacks reduce Razor Swipe's cooldown by 1.5 seconds.

level13.name: On the Prowl
level13.description: Inner Beast increases Movement Speed by 30% once it has been active for 3 seconds.

level16.name: Eager Wolf
level16.description: Increases the Attack Speed bonus of Inner Beast by an additional 40% after it has been active for 4 seconds.

level16.name: Lord of His Pack
level16.description: Attacking a Hero that is Slowed, Rooted, or Stunned increases Greymane's Basic Attack damage by 25% for 3 seconds, increased to 50% while in Worgen Form.

level16.name: Alpha Killer
level16.description: Worgen Basic Attacks against Heroes deal bonus damage equal to 3% of the Hero's maximum Health.

level20.name: Unleashed
level20.description:
Passive: Go For The Throat's damage is increased by 25%.

If Go for the Throat kills its target, refund its Mana cost and reset the cooldowns of Greymane's Abilities.

level20.name: Gilnean Roulette
level20.description: Cursed Bullet's damage is reduced to 30% of current health but its cooldown is reduced by 24 seconds.

level20.name: Hunter's Blunderbuss
level20.description: Human Basic Attacks splash for 100% damage behind the target.

level20.name: Tooth and Claw
level20.description: Worgen Basic Attacks cleave for 100% damage. Increase Razor Swipe's damage by 100%.
